hints.title: One digit at a time
hints.body: For the first digit, you must choose one of its letters. For each choice, the rest of the problem is the same with one fewer digit. What kind of process is that?

hints.title: Build prefixes
hints.body: Carry a prefix through the digits. At each position, append each possible letter and recurse to the next position. When no digits remain, the prefix is a complete word.

hints.title: Recurse over the position
hints.body: A helper takes the current digit index and the prefix. If the index equals the digit count, record the prefix. Otherwise loop over the letters for that digit, append one, recurse, and then remove it.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
function walk(index, prefix):
    if index == length(digits):
        add prefix to results
        return
    for letter in lettersFor(digits[index]):
        walk(index + 1, prefix + letter)

walk(0, "")
return results
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. The empty input is not part of this problem.
